description: This file is a React component named `RecommendationGrid` that displays a grid of role recommendations based on a persona. It fetches recommendation data from API endpoints, manages state for roles, loading, and errors, and renders a responsive layout with role cards and an optional analysis button.

methods.name: RecommendationGrid
methods.description: React functional component that fetches and displays a grid of recommended roles based on persona ID, with expandable role cards and an optional analysis button.
